name: Grid-Free Out-Of-Core Voxelization to Sparse Voxel Octrees
aliases: GPU-based Out-of-Core SVO Builder without Atomics
Morton Queue and Stitch Queue SVO Creation
definition: A stream-based out-of-core voxelization technique that processes triangles and voxels in batches to build Sparse Voxel Octrees (SVOs) on the GPU, avoiding grid-based structures and atomic operations by predicting voxel counts and using Morton ordering.
summary: This GPU-based technique builds Sparse Voxel Octrees out-of-core without atomic operations or global grids, using Morton ordering and batch processing to manage voxel locality efficiently.
